description:
Check the status of one ask by ask_id. **Until someone has actually gone and answered, `answer` is null — do not invent an answer in its place.** Tell the user it is still waiting for a person. The entire point of this service is that nothing is made up.
按 ask_id 查一单到哪一步了。**没人答之前 answer 是 null——这时候不要替他编一个答案**，如实告诉用户还在等人。
name: get_ask_answer
title: 查那个人答了没有
